purpose: Teach: クリティカル/全会/総局/複写/扶桑社/スポークスマン/図版/中味

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、クリティカルな事案には特捜班を編成されますね
lines.en: Police do form special task forces for critical cases, don't they.
lines.style: Light, conversational. Observational tone—noting something he's learned or noticed. Steady pace, no urgency. Friendly acknowledgment rather than question.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、議会の全会一致で防犯予算が承認されましたね
lines.en: The budget for crime prevention was approved unanimously by the Diet, wasn't it.
lines.style: Same conversational rhythm as before. Slightly impressed—a fact he finds interesting. Warm but measured. No edge of skepticism.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本部総局との連携を強化されますね
lines.en: You're strengthening coordination between the precinct and headquarters, I hear.
lines.style: Continues the same gentle, fact-checking pace. Mild curiosity. The tone of someone confirming what he's picked up through observation or news.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の複写は厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: And I imagine statement copies are managed pretty carefully.
lines.style: Slightly more personal now—a guess, a deduction. Still warm. Pace unchanged but a faint note of thoughtfulness, like he's thinking aloud with someone he trusts.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、扶桑社系のメディアからの取材にもご対応ですね
lines.en: You're also responding to interview requests from Fusosha-affiliated media, aren't you.
lines.style: Back to observational, nearly neutral. No judgment in the delivery. A statement of fact stated as a gentle inquiry. Steady warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署のスポークスマンが市民に説明されますね
lines.en: The station spokesman explains things to the public, doesn't he.
lines.style: Easier now—almost conversational relief. He's stepping back into neutral observation. Slight warmth returning. Pace remains unhurried, like he's just thinking out loud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、防犯ポスターの図版を充実されてますね
lines.en: And I've noticed your crime prevention posters have really been fleshed out.
lines.style: Approving but understated. A compliment delivered as observation. Friendly, genuine. Still no performance—just a man noticing something good.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、報告書の中味も丁寧に精査されますね
lines.en: The content of your reports gets reviewed pretty carefully too, I imagine.
lines.style: Shift to more reflective, almost thoughtful. Slower. A note of respect underlying the words. Still friendly but with weight—he's genuinely impressed by the diligence. Slight trailing-off, like admiration.
